newsitem.title: UK: Biggam to head UK's ITC television watchdog.
newsitem.headline: Biggam to head UK's ITC television watchdog.

text.p: Sir Robin Biggam will succeed Sir George Russell as chairman of UK's Independent Television Commission (ITC) from Jan 1, National Heritage Secretary Virginia Bottomley said Thursday.

Biggam, chairman of specialist engineering company Fairey Group Plc and a non-executive director of several leading UK firms, has been appointed for five years after Russell's term in office came to an end.
The ITC licences all commercial television services in the UK including terrestrial, cable and satellite channels.
"The ITC chairmanship is one of the most important posts in the UK broadcasting industry," said Bottomley.

"Sir Robin Biggam brings to the task wide ranging business experience, including within the communications sector. I am confident that he will command the respect of the Commission, the industry and the viewing public," she added.
